observed_symptoms: Bus voltage dropped to 18.6V during high-power imaging payload pass.
resolution_applied: Shed non-essential optical payload and switched to low-bandwidth telemetry profile.
outcome: Bus voltage stabilized to 27.2V within 12 minutes. No battery cell damage observed.
lessons_learned: Early payload load reduction prevented bus drop below critical 16.0V survival threshold.

observed_symptoms: Battery pack 1 temperature elevated to 52.3°C following eclipse exit.
resolution_applied: Throttled payload processing and transitioned thermal subsystem to safe thermal mode.
outcome: Temperature peaked at 53.1°C and dropped to 31.8°C within 180 seconds.
lessons_learned: Prioritizing payload throttling before safe thermal mode activation avoided attitude perturbations.

observed_symptoms: Reaction wheel 2 speed jitter exceeded 450 RPM with attitude error peaking at 0.35 deg.
resolution_applied: Reduced non-essential slewing maneuvers and switched to redundant star tracker / rate sensor channel.
outcome: Attitude error normalized to 0.02 deg within 150 seconds.
lessons_learned: Switching to redundant sensing resolved control loop instability caused by noisy sensor channel.
